summary: Exact case-insensitive filename-literal scanning of the supplied WCC/WBB MMUD, MMPLS, and MMUTL images proves which shipped support assets are statically named by those modules and which are not.

negative_findings.scope: all supplied WCC/WBB MMUD.DLL, MMPLS.DLL, and MMUTL.EXE images

closure: HSE and STO payload grammar and distribution coverage remain proven from the files themselves.
No direct filename-literal consumer or fallback branch for HSE/STO exists in the supplied native images.
Exact HSE/STO open/fallback behavior cannot be promoted beyond the existing data contract from these binaries alone.
Reforged must keep HSE/STO loading distribution-scoped and fail closed rather than inventing a native fallback.
limits: This scan does not exclude dynamically constructed filenames, host-side loading, database-side expansion, or consumers in binaries not supplied.
Absence of a literal is not evidence that the asset is unused; it is evidence that direct static literal tracing is unavailable in this module set.
